name: stage65-vmess-aead-tcp-dataplane-gate
gate_decision: stage65 admits only the VMess AEAD raw TCP Rust true dataplane row: the opt-in smoke validates EAuthID checksum, AEAD request header length/payload, VMess version/options/security, TCP command, target stage65-vmess.example:443, SHAKE128 masked AES-128-GCM body chunk, encrypted response header, payload echo, SO_MARKed TCP underlay, MPTCP status, and benchmark; VMess TLS/shared transports/UDP packet addr/mux, VLESS remaining rows, SS2022, and default/product switches remain closed

rows.evidence: SOCKS5, HTTP CONNECT, ordinary Shadowsocks AEAD TCP+UDP, trojanc TCP, Trojan UDP-over-TCP, VLESS raw TCP, VLESS UDP-over-TCP, and VLESS mux rows are carried from previous gates
rows.boundary: carried VLESS and earlier protocol evidence does not satisfy VMess AEAD, VMess shared transport, SS2022, QUIC-family, AnyTLS, or default-switch rows
rows.next_action: keep prior rows as prerequisites while continuing VMess and remaining protocol gates

rows.area: VMess AEAD raw TCP data plane
rows.evidence: Stage 65 writes a VMess AEAD request header, validates EAuthID checksum, decrypts AEAD header length/payload, parses version/options/security/target, transfers an AES-128-GCM body chunk with SHAKE128 length masking, and returns encrypted response header plus payload echo
rows.boundary: this covers only AEAD raw TCP with security auto/AES-128-GCM and does not cover TLS, WS, gRPC, HTTP/H2, HTTPUpgrade, Meek, xHTTP, UDP packet addr, mux, replay filter stress, or chacha20-poly1305
rows.next_action: carry VMess AEAD TCP as partial VMess evidence and split remaining VMess rows

rows.evidence: TLS, WS, gRPC, HTTP/H2, HTTPUpgrade, Meek, and xHTTP are not executed by the raw TCP gate
rows.boundary: VMess raw TCP cannot be treated as VMess shared-transport completion
rows.next_action: add transport-specific VMess gates or keep Go fallback

rows.evidence: UDP packet-addr and mux commands are not executed by this gate
rows.boundary: TCP chunk echo cannot satisfy UDP packet conn or mux lifecycle behavior
rows.next_action: split VMess UDP packet addr and mux rows if they are promoted before default switch

rows.evidence: several protocol rows remain incomplete and matched Go default daemon benchmarking is still missing
rows.next_action: continue per-protocol rows and matched Go/Rust daemon benchmark before reopening default switch
